title: Schedule an item not on the itinerary

steps.name: Start with a small plan
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Build with a visit date, add **African Lion** only, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: **African Lion** is on the itinerary; **Grevy's Zebra** is not.

steps.name: Open Schedule an item
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and click **Schedule an item**.

steps.name: Search outside itinerary
steps.do: Set **Item type** to **Animal**. Leave **Only show items on my itinerary** unchecked. Search for **Grevy's Zebra** and select it.
steps.expect: **Grevy's Zebra** appears in search results and can be selected.

steps.name: Choose a time and schedule
steps.do: Set a **Schedule time** inside zoo hours (for example **11:00 AM**), then click **Schedule**.
steps.expect: **Add to Itinerary?** appears with message **This item is not on your itinerary yet. Do you want to add it and schedule a time?** Confirm uses **Add to Schedule**.

steps.name: Confirm add to schedule
steps.expect: The dialog closes and scheduling succeeds.

steps.name: Timeline shows the new item
steps.expect: **Grevy's Zebra** has a timeline pill at the scheduled time.

steps.name: List includes the animal
steps.expect: **Grevy's Zebra** appears under animals alongside **African Lion**.
